description.narrative: IFC expects the Project to contribute to improved food security for consumers by increasing the production of modern, efficient grain storage silos in Brazil, which will help alleviate infrastructure bottlenecks in Brazil resulting in increased availability of food to the market. The Project will also preserve and create employment both directly and in the supply chain and increase value addition in the Brazilian economy. Beyond the Project, IFC anticipates that its financing will contribute to promoting resilience in the global food supply market

The proposed investment consists of an A Loan of up to BRL150 million in BRL equivalent to Kepler Weber Industrial S.A. (Kepler, KW or the Company), the leading company in the storage and post-harvest solutions sector in Latin America. The Company has requested IFC to finance its BRL150 million capital expenditure plan for 2022-2024 which includes the expansion of manufacturing capacity, plant modernization and productivity improvements (The Project). The IFC investment is also expected to be structured as an Incentive Based Loan focused assisting the company in obtaining the EDGE Gender Certification and developing a Sustainability Linked Framework based on EDGEs Action Plan.
